Opposite him, the blonde woman in the lavender hoodie (R2) stands on the right, profile facing left, smiling back. The man and the blonde woman are holding their raised hands together in a firm clasp between them at chest height. The background is softly blurred with bright overhead fluorescent lights and warm yellow tones, creating a friendly and energetic atmosphere.
